title: My Family
content: Hello, my name is Tom. This is my family. We are five people. My father is a doctor. My mother is a teacher. I have one brother and one sister. We live in a small house. I love my family very much.

questions.question: How many people are in the family?
What does the mother do?

title: My School Day
content: I get up at seven every morning. I go to school by bus. Classes start at eight. I have lunch at school. In the afternoon, I play games with my friends in the playground. I go home at five. In the evening, I do my homework and read a book.

questions.question: How does the writer go to school?
What time do classes start?

title: The Little Cat
content: Tom has a little cat. The cat is white and very cute. It likes to play with a red ball. It sleeps on the sofa every afternoon. Tom gives it milk and fish. The cat is his best friend.

questions.question: What color is the cat?
The passage says the cat likes to eat apples.
用英文写一句关于这只小猫的句子。
questions.modelAnswer: 示例：The little cat is white and very cute.

title: My Pet Dog
content: Tom has a small dog. It is brown and has big eyes. The dog can run fast and jump high. Every morning, Tom takes the dog for a walk in the park. The dog likes to chase balls. Tom loves his dog very much.

questions.question: What color is the dog?
The dog can jump very high.

title: My Breakfast
content: I eat breakfast every morning. I usually have bread, milk and an egg. My sister likes cereal with fruit. My mother makes breakfast for us. I do not eat breakfast at school. A good breakfast gives me energy for the day.

questions.question: What does the writer usually have for breakfast?
用英文写出你早餐通常吃什么。
questions.modelAnswer: 示例：I usually have milk and bread for breakfast.

title: I Like Swimming
content: I like swimming very much. I go to the swimming pool every Saturday. The water is cool and clean. I can swim with my friends. We play games in the water. Swimming is fun and good for my body. I want to swim every day.

questions.question: When does the writer go swimming?
The writer wants to swim every day.

title: My Weekend
content: On Saturday, I play football with my friends in the morning. In the afternoon, I watch cartoons on TV. On Sunday, my family goes to the market. We buy fruit and vegetables. I also help my mother cook dinner. I like weekends because they are fun.

questions.question: What does the writer do on Saturday morning?
Where does the family go on Sunday?

title: The Beautiful Park
content: There is a big park near my house. There are many tall trees and colorful flowers. I can see birds in the trees. There is a small lake with ducks. I go to the park with my parents. We sit on a bench and talk.

questions.question: There is a big lake in the park.
What do the writer and the parents do in the park?
options: Sit on a bench and talk
questions.answer: Sit on a bench and talk

title: My Books
content: I love reading books. I have many books at home. My favorite books are about animals. I read before I go to sleep. My teacher says reading is good for me. I go to the library every week. I can borrow new books there.

questions.question: What are the writer's favorite books about?
Where does the writer borrow books? 请用英文回答。
questions.modelAnswer: 示例：The writer borrows books from the library.

title: Going to the Doctor
content: Yesterday, I did not feel well. My mother took me to the doctor. The doctor looked at me carefully. She said I had a cold. She gave me some medicine. I went home and slept. Today I feel much better. I am happy now.

questions.question: What was wrong with the writer?
The writer went to the hospital by himself.

title: 购物清单
content: Anna goes to the supermarket. She wants to buy some chicken and a glass of juice. The food costs three dollars. After shopping, she goes home by bus.

questions.question: What does Anna want to buy?
What drink does Anna want to buy?
How much does the food cost?
Anna goes shopping by bike.

title: 我的宠物
content: Tom has a rabbit at home. It is yellow and very friendly. Every day Tom gives it some water. In the evening, they go for a walk to the supermarket. Tom loves a rabbit very much.

questions.question: What pet does Tom have at home?
What color is Tom’s pet?
Where do they go for a walk in the evening?
Tom’s pet is not friendly.

title: 愉快的一天
content: Ben gets up early and goes to the school with his friends. They eat some chicken for lunch there. In the afternoon they play games. Ben thinks it is a happy day.

questions.question: Where does Ben go with his friends?
What do they eat for lunch?
Ben thinks it is a happy day.
